comment: Overall, great professor. Homework is due once a week. Test questions are based on the lecture slides and homework questions, so if you show up and pay attention, you will do well. He's always willing to help you better understand things and explains concepts very well to non-science students. Glad I took his class!

I took his course in the spring of 2020. He was more so just a bad person in general. It was a tough semester with Covid just beginning and everything was moved to online. On top of this I lost both of my grandoarents. Absolutely zero sympathy was given grading was very unclear I still to this day have no idea how I ended up with a D

Not sure what's with the poor ratings. I though Dr. Singal was a great professor and a great lecturer who clearly knows his stuff. He does get a bit lecture heavy at times, which causes him to brush over questions, so make sure to be persistent with your question. Oh yeah, do not skip class or you will be lost.

Stay away if possible. Lectures are drawn out and made complicated by focusing more on deriving equations than actually using them. While available for office hours, he was not helpful. Homework problems were way more challenging than material covered in class and tests were very tough. Not good at explaining topics to first-time physics students.

Professor Singal cares more about demonstrating the difficulty of physics rather elucidating it. Lectures are long and consist almost entirely of deriving formulas and not actually using them to solve problems. Homework is graded for accuracy despite never being given problems similar to them in class. Tests range from easy to extremely difficult.

His homework assignments were super lengthy but he had office hours and promoted bi-weekly tutoring sessions to help with those! Homework prepared you for tests. He deserves an award for how smoothly he was able to transition both the lecture and lab portions of the course to online learning when we went remote. Hard class, but great professor!

He is a great professor. The class is very interesting, but also note that this is not a very discussion based class. The readings are long and tedious. Otherwise, the class is very straightforward, and the essay prompts are also clear. Again, the only thing is the class materials and in class lectures can be unexciting, or difficult to get through

Dr. Singal is absolutely a wonderful teacher!! I really like his FYS talking about pseudoscience. I learned a lot from his class. The reading and watching materials are really fun, and the final project isn't heavy as well. He only wants you to write 3 papers in total for this course, and his homework (reading) isn't much.

Be ready, physics isn't too easy. Dr. Singal is very clear in his lectures, he basically gives you the notes. Homeworks are a great help, so do them! There are two tests, 20% each; labs 15%; homeworks 15%; final 30%. The lecture is usually 1 and a half, but he gives a break, and the rest is lab. Could run long at times. Tests are not bad.

The subject is difficult, but Dr. Singal is outstanding at communicating the concepts and relating the lessons to applications in the world. He is always willing to provide extra help during office hours.

He is only easy to understand if you have a background knowledge in physics. He can come off as somewhat conceited through his joking demeanor but is generally helpful and nice. His tests are a shot in the dark as they can range from extremely easy to difficult and his lectures are longer than they should be. The labs are also a joke.
